# Watchlist brief: 2026-09-23

*Sample data for the test environment: prices and news are simulated.*

## Market backdrop

The S&P 500 rose 0.88% (z-score 1.2). Strongest sector: Consumer Discretionary (XLY) +2.07%; weakest: Communication Services (XLC) +0.29%. Unusual sector moves: Consumer Discretionary +2.07% (z-score 2.3), Industrials +1.72% (z-score 2.0).

## Notable moves

### JPM: +4.78% (z-score 3.04, volume 3.88x normal)
- **What happened:** JPM moved +4.78% on volume 3.88x normal.
- **Vs. sector and market:** JPM rose 4.78%; its sector (Financials, XLF) rose 1.35% and the S&P 500 rose 0.88%. That is 3.43 points better than its sector, an unusual gap for JPM (z-score 2.4), so the move looks specific to JPM.
- **Likely why:** Quarterly results beat expectations and guidance was raised. [Demo Markets Daily](https://news.example.com/2026-09-23/jpm-earnings)
- **Worth watching:** whether the move holds into the next session.

## Quiet

AAPL (-0.23%), MSFT (+0.18%), NVDA (+0.11%), AMZN (+1.56%)

## Coming up

- Wed Sep 23: JPMorgan Chase (JPM): Earnings report
- Wed Sep 23: JPMorgan Chase (JPM): Investor day
